subject: Shift request: live product demo paused pending Q4 close & exec travel
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@summitworks.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@summitworks.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed demo next week — hold request

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from our side — the CFO is out-of-region for most of the week of Feb 22 for an investor roadshow and our finance team is locked into quarter close activities through Feb 26. Given the timing, the execs who need to attend the walkthrough asked to push the live demo until after the close.

Can we pause the demo for this opportunity and reconvene the week of Mar 8–12? If the sales motion needs to keep momentum, Tom is happy to take a brief async recording of the demo in the meantime and we can schedule a short follow-up when the CFO is available.

Attaching: SummitWorks_Roadshow_Q1-2027.pdf (calendar overview)

Appreciate your flexibility — sorry for the short notice.

—Sara
Product Partnerships
SummitWorks
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@summitworks.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@summitworks.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed demo next week — hold request

Thanks for the heads-up, Sara. Totally understand — quarter close + exec travel is a tough window.

Two quick things:
- We can absolutely hold the live demo and reconvene the week of Mar 8–12. My team is available Mar 9 or Mar 11 in the afternoon PT; please let me know a preferred slot and I’ll send a calendar invite.
- In the interim, we’ll prepare a concise 20-minute recorded walkthrough (no slides, live product) and a tailored one-pager that highlights the integration and cost fit for your use case. If Tom can surface any specific questions or scenarios, we’ll address them in the recording.

I’ve attached our pre-demo checklist (Redwood_PreDemo_Checklist.pdf) so your team can flag anything you want covered. If finance prefers to wait until after the reforecast on Mar 3, that’s fine — we’ll use the time to tighten the SOW draft.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Sara Kim <sara.kim@summitworks.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed demo next week — hold request

Looping in a quick finance note from our side after speaking with procurement: SummitWorks’ PO/commit process will likely wait until their internal reforecast week (Mar 1–4) — they’ll need an updated cost estimate that reflects any revised spend buckets for FY28. That means we should plan our commercial ask for the week of Mar 8 at the earliest.

Recommendation:
- Keep the March live demo limited to exec + technical stakeholders (30–45 minutes). Focus on the Lightweight ROI section and the integration checklist so procurement can map the PO to the right spend line.
- We should send a tightened SOW and a high-level pricing table by Mar 5 so SummitWorks has time to include it in their reforecast materials.

I’ll prepare a one-page pricing summary and draft SOW (SOW-draft-v1.docx) and circulate by Mar 5. Neha — can you capture the technical acceptance criteria so we can attach it to the SOW?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Confirming March 11 live demo (30 min) + next steps

Sara / Tom — thanks for working through the dates. Confirming we’ve booked a 30-minute live demo on Thursday, Mar 11 at 2:00 PM PT (5:00 PM ET). Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=3a8f...march11

What we’ll deliver: 30-minute exec+tech walkthrough, 10 minutes for Q&A, and an outline of next commercial steps. Please expect the draft SOW and pricing summary by EOD Mar 5 (I’ll upload to the HubSpot deal and share the Drive link).

Action items:
- SummitWorks: confirm attendee list (exec + 2x engineering/infra) by Mar 4 
- Redwood: finalize SOW and pricing summary by Mar 5 (Rishi & Neha)
- If procurement needs a versioned packet for reforecast, we’ll label it v1 (internal) and follow with v2 after any pricing adjustments.

Attachments: Redwood_PreDemo_Checklist.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.docx

If anything changes with the CFO’s schedule and you need to move, ping me and we’ll rebook. Otherwise we’ll plan to record the demo and share it with any stakeholders who can’t attend live.

Best,
Jonas Weber
